name: Che Guevara's motorcycle journey
summary: A twenty-three-year-old medical student and his friend, a biochemist, set out from Buenos Aires on an old Norton 500 they call La Poderosa, the Mighty One, to see the continent. The bike gives out in Chile; they go on by lorry, raft and on foot, past the copper mine of Chuquicamata, through the Andes to Cusco and Machu Picchu, and down to a leper colony on the Amazon. Guevara's diary records a continent of poverty that he came to see as one country; it made him, in time, Che.

A Colombia at war with itself; they are arrested and released.
Granado stays to work; Guevara flies home to finish his degree.
